title: Industrial Electronics - Global Trends, Estimates and Forecasts, 2011-2018
主要内容: Reportlinker.com released a market research report on Industrial Electronics, forecasting a value of US$321 billion by 2018. The Asia-Pacific region is expected to show the highest compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17.0%, while Europe and North America closely track with 15% CAGR. Semiconductor capital equipment accounts for 32.2% of the market share, followed by process control instrumentation at 22.8%. The report covers global industrial electronics market trends, estimates, and forecasts from 2011 to 2018, including market distribution across regions such as North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Rest of World. Over 1346 market players are identified, with 30 key companies profiled for their projected market activities. The report features 77 data charts on market shares, sales forecasts, and growth prospects. Strategic activities such as mergers, acquisitions, collaborations, and product launches are discussed. Key companies include ALTERA CORPORATION (USA), ANALOG DEVICES, INC. (ADI) (USA), BLUERADIOS, INC. (USA), CACTUS SEMICONDUCTOR, INC (USA), DOVER CORPORATION (USA), GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY (GE) (USA), HONEYWELL (USA), INTEL (USA), FUJI ELECTRIC HOLDINGS COMPANY, LIMITED, FUJITSU LIMITED (JAPAN), KHAITAN (INDIA), and many more.
